description: Na₂LiBe₂F₇ crystallizes in the tetragonal P̅42₁m space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.70 Å. Li is bonded to four equivalent F atoms to form LiF₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent BeF₄ tetrahedra. All Li-F bond lengths are 1.87 Å. Be is bonded to four F atoms to form BeF₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one BeF₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent LiF₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Be-F bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.62 Å. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one Be atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Be atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three equivalent Na and one Be atom.
